codebase.title: Quantum ESPRESSO
codebase.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-256 over typed sorted regular-file paths+bytes and symlink paths+safe targets

agent_authored.description: Quantum ESPRESSO is a plane-wave pseudopotential suite for electronic-structure calculations. It solves the Kohn-Sham equations self-consistently for periodic and molecular systems and, from that ground state, derives forces, stresses, phonons and dielectric response through density-functional perturbation theory, Hubbard parameters, time-dependent response spectra and Car-Parrinello molecular dynamics. The pinned tree is tag qe-7.6 (commit 9f93ddec427d2b9a45bb72d828c6d324f62fcabd) cloned with --recurse-submodules; it carries the project's own CUDA Fortran and OpenACC GPU paths, which are the human record an acceleration task must beat rather than a module to package. This registration is the return of the retired seed archive/sa-0004 in the current leaf format, with the source re-vendored at a current pin.
evidence: git rev-parse HEAD on the --recurse-submodules clone equals the pin; git describe --tags returns qe-7.6
License file at the root of the tree; the headers of PW/src carry GPL-2.0-or-later
README_GPU.md documents the official GPU build that this registration treats as the incumbent

agent_authored.generated_vendor_third_party_notes: external/ holds eight upstream git submodules vendored with the tree: lapack, fox, wannier90, d3q, devxlib, mbd, qe-gipaw and pw2qmcpack. All eight are populated; none is empty. Only devxlib and mbd are compiled by the CPU recipe used here (make pw, or make pw ph); wannier90 is reachable only from the epw and w90 targets and is vendored but not built. external/lapack is Fortran 77 and dominates the .f line count without being compiled, because configure finds the system OpenBLAS. Four files larger than 10 MB were removed from the payload, all of them example, reference or documentation data inside external/: external/d3q/Examples/MgO/reference/LW/final_q0_qresolved_T300_s5.out (72150170 bytes); external/d3q/Examples/Tutorial2016/DAY3-ANHARMONICITY/PART5/pdh_mat3R.asr.sparse (25659698 bytes); external/wannier90/doc/compiled_docs/solution_booklet.pdf (15170909 bytes); external/wannier90/test-suite/checkpoints/fe_postw90/Fe.uHu.bz2 (10635499 bytes). Two zero-byte files were ADDED to the payload: install/git_devx and install/git_mbd. They are the stamp files QE's own install/extlibs_makefile writes after a successful submodule update; without them a tree whose .git directories have been removed re-runs git init + git fetch + git checkout against the network on every build and then aborts, because the submodule working trees are already populated. install/git_w90 is deliberately not added. pseudo/ additionally carries 64 pseudopotential files downloaded from https://pseudopotentials.quantum-espresso.org/upf_files/, which upstream's test-suite/check_pseudo.sh fetches at run time; every file in pseudo/ is listed in pseudo/SAB-MANIFEST.sha256 with sha256, byte size and origin.

shared_components.purpose: Everything every module links against: the QE Modules layer (cell, ions, k-points, symmetry, pseudopotential handling, I/O and the XML schema writer), the FFT driver library FFTXlib, the linear-algebra layer LAXlib, the low-level utilities UtilXlib, the exchange-correlation library XClib, the UPF pseudopotential reader upflib, the linear-response infrastructure LR_Modules shared by PHonon, TDDFPT and HP, the build system in install/ with the generated make.inc, and the vendored third-party sources in external/ and the Grimme D3 dispersion code in dft-d3/.

modules.title: PWscf plane-wave self-consistent ground state
modules.expensive_path: The Hamiltonian application h_psi: vloc_psi (three-dimensional FFTs per band, forward and back) plus the non-local projectors calbec/add_vuspsi (BLAS3 on the beta-projector block), driven by the Davidson iterative diagonaliser cegterg; then sum_band, the USPP/PAW augmentation newd/addusdens, and the force/stress assembly. On any non-trivial cell this is where essentially all the wall time goes.
modules.rationale: One self-consistent field loop over a plane-wave basis is one indivisible scientific object: the basis, the iterative diagonaliser, the charge-density mixing, the exchange-correlation and Hartree potentials, the ultrasoft/PAW augmentation and the force and stress theorems all close on each other through the same density and the same wavefunction storage. Splitting the diagonaliser from the density loop would give two halves neither of which computes an observable. The hybrid-functional operator is the one part that is separable, because it enters only as an extra term in h_psi through a well defined interface, and it is proposed as its own module.
excluded: PW/src/exx.f90, exx_base.f90, exx_bp.f90, exx_bp_utils.f90 and exx_std.f90: the exact-exchange operator is owned by pw-hybrid-exx, so PW/src is listed here file by file with those five left out and the ownership accounting carries no overlap
PW/tools: post-processing and geometry helpers, not part of the SCF loop
PWCOND, PP, NEB and the other drivers that consume a PWscf ground state rather than compute one
hazards: Iteration counts, estimated scf accuracy, timings and G-vector/plane-wave/k-point counts are bookkeeping and must never be graded
Empty bands are not converged to the SCF threshold when diago_full_acc is false, so only occupied states are observables
BLAS and FFT thread pools size themselves from the host core count unless OMP_NUM_THREADS and OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS are pinned
Relax and vc-relax decks end on a BFGS geometry whose numerical sensitivity is much larger than the SCF energy's
Several official inputs need pseudopotential files that upstream downloads at run time; the containers have no network

Splitting the diagonaliser from the density loop would give two halves neither of which computes an observable. primary_inputs: a PWscf input deck (&CONTROL/&SYSTEM/&ELECTRONS namelists, ATOMIC_SPECIES, ATOMIC_POSITIONS, K_POINTS)
UPF pseudopotential files resolved through ESPRESSO_PSEUDO

algorithm_stages: read the deck, set up the cell, symmetry and the plane-wave/FFT grids
initialise the density and the Kohn-Sham potential
iterative diagonalisation (Davidson cegterg, or CG, PPCG, ParO, RMM-DIIS) of H at each k-point

on convergence, assemble forces (Hellmann-Feynman plus Pulay) and the stress tensor

the ultrasoft and PAW augmentation of the density and the potential
not_responsible_for: PW/src/exx.f90, exx_base.f90, exx_bp.f90, exx_bp_utils.f90 and exx_std.f90: the exact-exchange operator is owned by pw-hybrid-exx

PWCOND, PP, NEB and the other drivers that consume a PWscf ground state rather than compute one

modules.title: PWscf hybrid functionals: the exact-exchange operator
entrypoints: pw.x with a hybrid input_dft (B3LYP, HSE, gau-pbe, X3LYP, PBE0)
modules.expensive_path: vexx, the pair-density Poisson solve over occupied-band pairs and q-points, and the ACE (adaptively compressed exchange) construction and application that replaces it inside the inner SCF loop. Its cost scales as the square of the number of occupied bands and dominates every hybrid run.
modules.rationale: Exact exchange enters the ground-state code through one interface, as an additional operator inside h_psi, and carries its own outer-loop convergence, its own q-point machinery and its own ACE representation. It is the one part of PW/src that can be replaced wholesale without touching the semi-local SCF loop, and the hybrid official tests exercise it and nothing else that pw-ground-state does not already cover.
excluded: The semi-local SCF loop itself, owned by pw-ground-state
Hybrid functionals routed through libxc, which is not in the image
hazards: Hybrid runs are far slower than semi-local ones; several official hybrid inputs exceed a three-minute serial budget
The ACE representation changes the inner-loop trajectory without changing the converged answer, so iteration counts are meaningless as a check
Some hybrid inputs in pw_uspp and pw_noncolin belong to this module rather than to pw-ground-state
modules.purpose: Exact exchange enters the ground-state code through one interface, as an additional operator inside h_psi, and carries its own outer-loop convergence, its own q-point machinery and its own ACE representation. primary_inputs: a PWscf deck with a hybrid input_dft (B3LYP, X3LYP, HSE, gau-pbe, PBE0) and its exx_fraction/screening parameters
primary_outputs: the same data-file-schema.xml observables as the semi-local path, converged with exact exchange in the Hamiltonian
algorithm_stages: an inner semi-local SCF to produce a starting density
build the exact-exchange operator over occupied-band pairs and the q-point grid (vexx)
compress it into the ACE representation and apply that inside the inner SCF
outer loop until the exact-exchange energy itself is converged
unique_responsibilities: the exact-exchange operator and its ACE representation
the q-point machinery and the divergence treatment that exact exchange needs
not_responsible_for: The semi-local SCF loop itself, owned by pw-ground-state
Hybrid functionals routed through libxc, which is not in the image
modules.differences: It owns only the five exx* files of PW/src and nothing else. It cannot run without the semi-local SCF of pw-ground-state, but the semi-local SCF never enters this code, so the boundary is one operator inside h_psi.
evidence: PW/src/exx.f90 and exx_base.f90 hold vexx and the ACE construction

modules.title: Density-functional perturbation theory: phonons and response
modules.expensive_path: solve_linter, the self-consistent solution of the Sternheimer equation for each perturbation and each q-point: the conjugate-gradient solver cgsolve_all applied to the linear system, the perturbing potential dvqpsi_us, the induced-density accumulation incdrhoscf and the drhodv contraction. Each irreducible perturbation costs roughly one ground-state SCF calculation.
modules.rationale: Linear-response phonons are one coherent physical calculation with one expensive kernel: build the perturbation, solve the Sternheimer equation self-consistently, accumulate the induced density, contract into the dynamical matrix. The post-processing executables (dynmat.x for IR and Raman, q2r.x and matdyn.x for Fourier interpolation, lambda.x for electron-phonon coupling) read the dynamical matrices that ph.x writes and are the same scientific object seen at the end of the chain, so they belong to the same module rather than to separate ones.
excluded: EPW, which builds on PHonon output but needs Wannier90 and long runs
The ground-state SCF that must precede every phonon run, owned by pw-ground-state
Third-order anharmonic response in external/d3q, an optional external component
hazards: Every ph_* official test is a chain: an scf step then one or more ph steps, sometimes then q2r/matdyn/dynmat; the steps must run in the jobconfig order and share one working directory
ph.x never purges its own _ph0 restart directory, so a stale _ph0 silently changes a later run
Acoustic modes at Gamma are only zero after the acoustic sum rule, and their raw values sit at the numerical floor
dynmat.x, matdyn.x and lambda.x write formatted text whose printed precision, not the physics, floors any tolerance derived from them
The dynamical matrix has a machine-readable XML form only when fildyn ends in .xml
modules.purpose: Linear-response phonons are one coherent physical calculation with one expensive kernel: build the perturbation, solve the Sternheimer equation self-consistently, accumulate the induced density, contract into the dynamical matrix. The post-processing executables (dynmat.x for IR and Raman, q2r.x and matdyn.x for Fourier interpolation, lambda.x for electron-phonon coupling) read the dynamical matrices that ph.x writes and are the same scientific object seen at the end of the chain, so they belong to the same module rather than to separate ones.
primary_inputs: a converged PWscf ground state under outdir
a ph.x input naming the q-point or q-mesh, fildyn, and options such as epsil, lraman or electron_phonon
for the post-processing steps, the dynamical matrices ph.x wrote
primary_outputs: dynamical-matrix files (XML when fildyn ends in .xml): phonon frequencies, the dielectric tensor and Born effective charges
dynmat.x output: IR intensities, Raman activities and depolarisation ratios
q2r.x force constants and matdyn.x interpolated frequencies and phonon DOS
algorithm_stages: read the ground state and set up the perturbation symmetry and the irreducible representations
for each irreducible perturbation, build dvqpsi_us and solve the Sternheimer equation self-consistently (solve_linter -> cgsolve_all)
accumulate the induced density (incdrhoscf) and contract into the dynamical matrix (drhodv)
apply the acoustic sum rule and diagonalise for frequencies
post-process: Fourier interpolation (q2r/matdyn), IR and Raman (dynmat), electron-phonon (lambda)
unique_responsibilities: the self-consistent linear response of the density to an atomic displacement or an electric field
the dynamical matrix and everything derived from it
the perturbation-symmetry machinery specific to DFPT
not_responsible_for: EPW, which builds on PHonon output but needs Wannier90 and long runs
The ground-state SCF that must precede every phonon run, owned by pw-ground-state
Third-order anharmonic response in external/d3q, an optional external component
modules.differences: It never converges a ground state and never computes a total energy of its own; it linearises around one. It owns PHonon/, which no other module touches, and shares LR_Modules with tddfpt-linear-response and hp-hubbard-parameters.
evidence: PHonon/PH/solve_linter.f90 is the self-consistent response loop; cgsolve_all is the inner linear solve
PHonon/PH/phqscf.f90 drives the loop over irreducible representations
every ph_* official test begins with a pw.x step and continues with one or more ph.x steps in jobconfig order

modules.title: Car-Parrinello molecular dynamics
modules.expensive_path: The fictitious electron dynamics: runcp_uspp propagating the wavefunction coefficients, vofrho building the potential from the density each step, and the orthonormality constraint ortho, all inside a time-stepping loop that runs for thousands of steps.
modules.rationale: Car-Parrinello propagates the electrons as fictitious classical degrees of freedom instead of re-converging an SCF at every step. It is a different algorithm from PWscf with its own storage, its own constraint machinery and its own conserved quantities, and it lives in its own directory with its own official test suite.
excluded: Born-Oppenheimer molecular dynamics driven by pw.x, which belongs to pw-ground-state
cp inputs that route their functional through libxc
hazards: A dynamics trajectory amplifies a two-ulp perturbation; conserved quantities and averages may be the only sound observables
Several cp official tests are two-stage (a wavefunction-optimisation stage then a dynamics stage) sharing a restart file
modules.purpose: Car-Parrinello propagates the electrons as fictitious classical degrees of freedom instead of re-converging an SCF at every step. It is a different algorithm from PWscf with its own storage, its own constraint machinery and its own conserved quantities, and it lives in its own directory with its own official test suite.
primary_inputs: a cp.x deck (&CONTROL/&SYSTEM/&ELECTRONS/&IONS) and its restart file for a continued stage
primary_outputs: the .evp trajectory of energies and temperature, the ionic and electronic trajectories, and the restart file
algorithm_stages: wavefunction optimisation to the Born-Oppenheimer surface
Verlet propagation of the fictitious electronic degrees of freedom together with the ions
orthonormality constraint (ortho) at every step
potential rebuild from the density (vofrho) at every step
unique_responsibilities: the fictitious electron dynamics and its mass parameter
the constraint machinery that keeps the orbitals orthonormal along a trajectory
the conserved quantity of Car-Parrinello dynamics
not_responsible_for: Born-Oppenheimer molecular dynamics driven by pw.x, which belongs to pw-ground-state
cp inputs that route their functional through libxc
modules.differences: It replaces the SCF fixed point with a dynamics, so it shares neither the diagonalisers nor the mixing of pw-ground-state. It owns CPV/src alone.
evidence: CPV/src/cprstart.f90 and CPV/src/cpr.f90 drive the propagation loop
CPV/src/runcp.f90 and CPV/src/ortho.f90 hold the expensive path

modules.title: Time-dependent DFPT: optical and magnetic response spectra
modules.expensive_path: The Lanczos recursion (and, in the Davidson variant, the iterative eigen-solve) over the response space: each iteration applies the same linear-response operator that the phonon module applies, but to a charge or spin perturbation, and the number of iterations is the resolution of the spectrum.
modules.rationale: Turbo-TDDFPT computes spectra without ever diagonalising the full response matrix, by a Lanczos chain whose coefficients are the scientific output. The chain, its restart logic and the spectrum reconstruction form one object, and the module shares the LR_Modules infrastructure with the phonon module while owning a distinct physical question.
excluded: The ground-state and phonon calculations that supply its starting point
Hybrid-functional response paths that need libxc
hazards: The Lanczos coefficients, not the reconstructed spectrum, are the natural graded quantity; the spectrum is a derived text table
Chained tests: an scf run, then the Lanczos run, then the spectrum reconstruction
modules.purpose: Turbo-TDDFPT computes spectra without ever diagonalising the full response matrix, by a Lanczos chain whose coefficients are the scientific output. The chain, its restart logic and the spectrum reconstruction form one object, and the module shares the LR_Modules infrastructure with the phonon module while owning a distinct physical question.
primary_inputs: a converged ground state, then a turbo_lanczos/turbo_davidson/turbo_eels/turbo_magnon input naming the perturbation and the number of Lanczos iterations
primary_outputs: the Lanczos coefficients file, and the spectrum reconstructed from it by turbo_spectrum.x
algorithm_stages: read the ground state and set up the response operator
apply the perturbation and run the Lanczos recursion (or the Davidson eigen-solve)
write the recursion coefficients
reconstruct the spectrum by continued fraction
unique_responsibilities: the Lanczos recursion over the response space and its restart logic
the EELS and magnon perturbations that no other module implements
not_responsible_for: The ground-state and phonon calculations that supply its starting point
Hybrid-functional response paths that need libxc
modules.differences: It answers a spectroscopic question rather than a structural one, and it never builds a dynamical matrix. It shares LR_Modules with ph-linear-response but owns TDDFPT/src alone.
evidence: TDDFPT/src/lr_main.f90 drives the Lanczos chain; TDDFPT/src/lr_lanczos.f90 is the recursion

modules.title: Hubbard parameters from density-functional perturbation theory
modules.expensive_path: The DFPT+U response solves: one linear-response calculation per perturbed Hubbard site and q-point, each a Sternheimer solve like the phonon module's, followed by the assembly and inversion of the response matrices that give U and V.
modules.rationale: hp.x computes Hubbard U and inter-site V from first principles by perturbing site occupations. It is a self-contained calculation with its own directory, its own official tests and one clear observable, and it is the natural companion of the LDA+U ground-state path without being part of it.
excluded: The LDA+U ground-state SCF itself, owned by pw-ground-state
Empirical or fitted Hubbard parameters, which are inputs rather than outputs
hazards: Every hp test is a chain starting from a converged LDA+U scf run
U and V are printed in a formatted table whose precision floors the tolerance
Some inputs need many perturbed sites and exceed a three-minute serial budget
modules.purpose: hp.x computes Hubbard U and inter-site V from first principles by perturbing site occupations. It is a self-contained calculation with its own directory, its own official tests and one clear observable, and it is the natural companion of the LDA+U ground-state path without being part of it.
primary_inputs: a converged LDA+U ground state and an hp.x input naming the perturbed sites and the q-mesh
primary_outputs: the computed Hubbard U (and inter-site V) parameters and the response matrices they come from
algorithm_stages: read the LDA+U ground state and identify the Hubbard manifolds
perturb each site occupation in turn and solve the linear response self-consistently
assemble the bare and screened response matrices
invert them to obtain U and V
unique_responsibilities: the site-occupation perturbation and its response matrices
the matrix inversion that turns response into a Hubbard parameter
not_responsible_for: The LDA+U ground-state SCF itself, owned by pw-ground-state
Empirical or fitted Hubbard parameters, which are inputs rather than outputs
modules.differences: It computes a parameter of a model Hamiltonian rather than an observable of the system, which makes its output a small formatted table rather than a field. It owns HP/src alone.
evidence: HP/src/hp_main.f90 drives the loop over perturbed sites
HP/src/hp_solve_linear_system.f90 is the response solve
